inlines.v: HEBDOM'ADAL HEBDOM'ADARY, adjective Weekly; consisting of seven days, or occurring every seven days. HEBDOM'ADARY, noun A member of a chapter or convent, whose week it is to officiate in the choir, rehearse the anthems and prayers, and perform other services, which on extraordinary occasions are performed by the superiors.
